company: Global beverage majors advance India IPO plans, from DRHP filing to board’s nod
oneLine: Global beverage majors advance India IPO plans.

sources.title: Global beverage majors advance India IPO plans, from DRHP filing to board’s nod

synopsis: Three global beverage companies, Carlsberg, Pernod Ricard, and The Coca-Cola Company, are advancing plans to list their Indian businesses through initial public offerings at various stages. Carlsberg has filed an updated draft red herring prospectus with SEBI on October 28, 2026, and is engaging with potential investors. Pernod Ricard is continuing preparatory work for a potential listing of its Indian unit pending board approval, following strong sales growth in the September quarter. The Coca-Cola Company is exploring an IPO of its Indian bottling operations through Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings, following the Jubilant Bhartia Group's acquisition of a 40 per cent stake in HCCH last year. No deal amounts or specific timelines have been disclosed across these prospective offerings.
